name: Are wall and ceiling cracks a sign of serious structural issues?

mainEntity.name: Are wall and ceiling cracks a sign of serious structural issues?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hairline cracks frequently develop near door frames, window corners, and ceiling joints due to normal seasonal framing movement, especially during temperature and humidity shifts across the Denver metro area. However, widening cracks, diagonal stair-step cracks, or cracks accompanied by sticking doors may indicate structural settling or foundation movement. Hairline settlement cracks can be taped, mudded, and repainted, but any persistent or widening separation should be examined carefully before cosmetic repairs to ensure the underlying framing is stable.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most hairline cracks come from seasonal settling. However, wide, recurring cracks or sticking doors may signal deeper structural movement that needs evaluation.
